Cars

Cars

Find a car by its personality, then inspect the facts.

  • AWDStrong control and drift with restrained outright speed. TRACTION later makes shallow excursions less costly.↗
  • Learner CarSlow acceleration and speed give you time to react. Strong control, drift and a long BOOST tank make the first laps easier to read.↗
  • Sports CarQuick, well controlled and initially modest at drifting. DRIFT DEMON builds its drift ability during a sustained slide.↗
  • TractorVery slow on GAS, with strong control and a powerful, long BOOST. Its SMV identity makes it the DRIVE BY EAR training car.↗
  • SedanEvery base attribute is balanced. It is a clear way to feel what changing one setup does before learning a more specialised car.↗
  • SUVGood acceleration and control with a modest base tank. FULL TANK rewards clean driving by building and filling that tank.↗
  • TruckSolid control and drift with slower acceleration. TORQUE makes OVERCHARGE preparation central to the car’s character.↗
  • VanExcellent drift, a generous tank and modest straight-line speed. CARRY ON later reduces the speed lost in LOCK.↗
  • CompactModest speed with lively steering and drift. CLEAN EXIT helps you settle the car after a successful slide.↗
  • Vintage RacerA fast car with excellent drift but lighter steering control. DRIFTAGE holds speed and angle through linked corners.↗
  • Race CarHigh speed, acceleration and control favour accurate lines. Its short BOOST tank makes timing more important than holding the button.↗
  • Fire TruckMeasured pace, strong control and drift, and a full-size BOOST tank. SIRENS light up and sound while boosting.↗
  • Police CarHigher top speed with a long tank and mild BOOST power. SIRENS give each pursuit its emergency character.↗
  • AmbulanceA long BOOST tank and strong drift, with gentler acceleration. Smooth exits keep the car moving.↗
  • Future RacerMaximum base speed and acceleration, little drift and a short tank. OVERDRIVE rewards fast, clean driving with a rising speed cap.↗
  • Monster TruckBig, slide-friendly and patient at speed. OVERSIZED removes off-road slowdown; course boundaries and obstacles still matter.↗
  • Rally RacerFast and eager, with very little steering control and a small BOOST tank. TWITCHY TURNY makes drifting an especially quick refill.↗
  • SupercarStrong speed and acceleration with a balanced BOOST package. FLOW SHIFT rewards maintaining a varied chain of techniques.↗
